clock: Every native phase uses ProcessInfo.systemUptime; document observations stay separate
documentPhaseScope: Native receipts refer to the initial Home document for legacy and StarLocal for direct; final-document renderer/resource/engine observations remain separately labeled
limitations: Receipt stamps include IPC/test observer delay; unloaded initial documents may lack DOM/load receipts, which stay missing. No cross-clock subtraction or CPU/warning causal claim.
purpose: Locate intervals in one fixed diagnostic run; never replace/trim the original failing N10
